neet-ug.title: NEET Exam Photo Size: Photo, Signature & Thumb

neet-ug.description: NEET exam photo size (2026 bulletin): JPG photo 10–200 KB, signature 10–100 KB, finger-print sheet 50–200 KB. The 4×6 inch postcard photo is printed.
neet-ug.intro: As per the NEET (UG) 2026 bulletin, the NEET exam photo size is 10–200 KB in JPG, with no fixed pixel size; the signature is 10–100 KB. Use the NEET photo resizer kit below to make the passport-size upload photo, the signature and the finger-print sheet in one sitting. The 4×6 inch postcard size photo is not uploaded: you print it and paste it on the admit card proforma at the exam centre.
neet-ug.specH2: NEET exam photo size and signature size
neet-ug.aboutH2: NEET upload photo vs printed photos for the exam centre

faq.q: Do I need any printed photos for NEET?
faq.a: Yes. Keep a 4×6 inch colour print with a white background for the admit card proforma; it is not uploaded. See the NEET post card size photo page for the full rules and the print file.

faq.q: What is the NEET admit card photo size?
faq.a: The admit card prints the passport-size photo you uploaded (10–200 KB JPG). On exam day you also need one passport-size print of the same photo for the attendance sheet and a 4×6 inch postcard-size colour print with a white background for the proforma. Print passport-size copies with the passport photo sheet tool.

faq.q: Is a passport size photo fine for NEET?
faq.a: Yes. A passport-style photo with a white background, the face filling about 80% of the frame and both ears visible is what the 2026 form wants. SahiSize keeps 3.5×4.5 cm proportions and brings the file inside 10–200 KB.

postcard-photo.keyword: neet exam post card size photo
postcard-photo.title: NEET Exam Post Card Size Photo: 4×6 inch, White Background
postcard-photo.h1: NEET Exam Post Card Size Photo: 4×6 inch Colour Print
postcard-photo.description: NEET exam post card size photo: 4×6 inch, colour, white background. You print it and paste it on the admit card proforma; it is not uploaded.
postcard-photo.lead: The NEET exam post card size photo is a 4×6 inch colour photo with a white background. You do not upload it: you print it, take it to the exam centre and paste it on the proforma that comes with your admit card.

steps.name: Take the photo
steps.text: Stand against a plain white wall, facing the light, so the background stays white.

steps.name: Make the 4×6 inch file
steps.text: Add the photo in the tool above and pick 4×6 inch at 300 DPI. Crop so the white background shows around you, then download the JPG.

steps.name: Print it
steps.text: Print it in colour on 4×6 inch (postcard) photo paper at a photo shop or on a photo printer. Keep 4–6 prints.

steps.name: Paste it on exam day
steps.text: Paste one print on the proforma downloaded with the admit card and hand it in at the exam centre. Carry a passport-size print of your uploaded photo for the attendance sheet too.

faq.q: Do I upload the post card size photo in the NEET form?
faq.a: No. The NEET (UG) 2026 bulletin asks you to upload only a passport-size photo (10–200 KB JPG) and to take a live photo. The 4×6 inch postcard size photo is printed and pasted on the admit card proforma at the exam centre.

faq.q: What is the NEET post card size photo in cm?
faq.a: 4×6 inch is about 10.2×15.2 cm. Ask the photo shop for a 4×6 or postcard print; they are the same size.

faq.q: How many post card size photos do I need for NEET?
faq.a: The bulletin advises keeping 4–6 postcard-size (4×6 inch) and 6–8 passport-size colour photos with a white background.

faq.q: Can the NEET post card size photo be black and white?
faq.a: Keep it in colour. The bulletin asks for postcard-size colour photos with a white background. (The uploaded passport-size photo may be colour or black and white.)

faq.q: Where do I paste the NEET postcard photo?
faq.a: On the proforma you download with the NEET admit card. Paste the 4×6 inch photo in the box on it, take it to the exam centre and follow the instructions printed on the admit card.

faq.q: How do I do the UPSC photo upload from a phone?
faq.a: Make the photo here, save it, then pick it from Files or Gallery in the OTR profile or the application form. Upload the saved file as it is; sending it through WhatsApp first shrinks it below 20 KB.

faq.q: Can I reuse my UPSC CSE photo for NDA or CDS?
faq.a: Yes, if it is still recent. UPSC NDA and CDS forms take the same JPG photo of 20–200 KB through the same One-Time Registration profile.

faq.q: What is the DSSSB thumb impression size?
faq.a: The left and right thumbs are separate JPG uploads, each up to 40 KB. Press once on white paper with a stamp pad and photograph it in daylight; Clean thumb removes the grey paper tone.

faq.q: What is the DSSSB photo upload size in KB?
faq.a: 50–300 KB. Many DSSSB rejections are photos under 50 KB, because a passport-size face crop compresses too small. Keep the upper body in frame and Auto-fit lands it inside the range.

faq.q: Does the JEE Main photo need my name and date?
faq.a: Not in the 2026 bulletin as we read it: the photo rules ask for a recent colour photo on a white background, with no name-and-date strip. Older forms and some coaching guides mention a JEE Main photo with name and date, which is why people search for it. Follow your own bulletin; if it asks for the strip, add it before you upload.

gate.description: GATE exam photo size 2027: colour JPG, 3.5×4.5 cm, 200×260 to 530×690 px, up to 600 KB. Signature 250×80 to 580×180 px, up to 300 KB. Resize free.
gate.intro: The GATE exam photo size for GATE 2027 is a colour JPG of 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm, between 200×260 and 530×690 pixels (width:height 0.66–0.89), up to 600 KB, on a white background. The signature is a JPG between 250×80 and 580×180 pixels, up to 300 KB, in black or dark blue ink. Make both below on your phone, then read the rejection rules from the IIT Madras brochure.
gate.aboutH2: GATE photo and signature rules from the brochure

faq.q: What is the GATE exam photo size in KB?
faq.a: The GATE 2027 brochure sets a maximum of 600 KB for the photo; the GATE 2027 website also gives a minimum of 5 KB. SahiSize makes a JPG inside that range at about 530×681 pixels, which keeps the 3.5×4.5 cm shape.

faq.q: What is the GATE photo size in pixels?
faq.a: Between 200×260 and 530×690 pixels, with a width:height ratio between 0.66 and 0.89. A 3.5×4.5 cm passport-style photo fits this ratio.

faq.q: What is the GATE signature size?
faq.a: A JPG between 250×80 and 580×180 pixels, with the width 2.75 to 3.75 times the height, up to 300 KB (the website also gives a 3 KB minimum). Sign in black or dark blue ink; ALL CAPITALS, initials only and digital signatures are not accepted.

faq.q: How much of the GATE photo should my face cover?
faq.a: 60–70% of the image after cropping, per the GATE 2027 website. Show your forehead, eyes, nose and chin, facing the camera, on a white background with no other objects or people.
